cards.title: Icon library strategy (adopt, extend, or draw your own)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Default to the platform-native set on native apps and one open-source set on web. Draw custom icons only for domain concepts the library lacks, using the library's own template so stroke, radius and keylines match [inferred from S-L05-001, S-L05-010].

cards.title: Icon style (outline, filled, duotone; rounded, sharp)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Outlined at rest, filled for selected. Match corner style to the component radius family: pill/rounded buttons pair with rounded icons, 0-2px radius UIs pair with sharp icons [S-L05-003].

cards.title: Stroke weight, corners and terminals (matching type)
cards.block: Foundations > Iconography > Stroke and corner metrics
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Set icon stroke so that icon weight visually equals your body text weight at the paired size: roughly 1.5px for 14-16px text with a regular-weight sans, 2px at 24px [inferred from S-L05-016, S-L05-021, S-L05-024]. Pick caps to echo the typeface: geometric or rounded sans leads to round caps, grotesk or slab leads to square caps [inferred].

cards.title: Icon grid, keylines, live area and padding
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Use the Material 24/20/2 construction unless your master size is 16 or 32. Always pixel-align at the smallest shipped size, since that is where blur shows first [S-L05-001] [S-L05-017].

cards.title: Icon size scale and optical sizing
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Ship 16, 20, 24 (plus 12 and 32 if needed). Pair icon size to the line height of adjacent text rather than to font size: 16px icon with 14px text, 20px with 16px, 24px with 20px titles [inferred from S-L05-016].

cards.title: Icon state conventions (selected, active, disabled, emphasis)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Outline at rest, filled plus accent color when selected (two cues, so it survives color-blindness). Keep hover/pressed feedback on the container, not the glyph, as Carbon does [S-L05-016].

cards.title: Icon and label pairing (when icons need text, alignment, spacing)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Label everything in navigation. Allow icon-only for about a dozen universal actions (search, close, more, add, delete, edit, share, settings) with a tooltip and accessible name. Center-align icons to the text line box [S-L05-016] [S-L05-037] [inferred list].

cards.title: Icon color and rendering mode
cards.default: (default + heuristic) One neutral icon color aliased to the secondary text color, semantic colors only on status icons, and no decorative multicolor in UI chrome. Test icons at the 3:1 floor, 4.5:1 if they sit on the same line as body text [S-L05-016] [S-L05-034].

cards.title: Icon metaphors, naming and localization
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Name assets by shape, expose a function-alias layer in the component API, record RTL behavior per icon, and test metaphors in each launch market [S-L05-003] [S-L05-014] [S-L05-018].

cards.title: Icon delivery and encoding (how icons ship)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Ship SVG source of truth, generate per-framework components and native packages from it, name files `<name>_<size>_<style>`, and keep size and color as tokens. Use a variable icon font only if you need live weight/fill interpolation [S-L05-002] [S-L05-018] [S-L05-038].

cards.title: Icon tiers beyond UI icons (pictograms and spot icons)
cards.block: Foundations > Iconography > Tiers (UI icon, pictogram, spot icon)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Add a pictogram tier only if you have marketing surfaces; draw it with the UI icon's stroke logic scaled up so the two feel related (IBM and Dropbox both derive icon tiers from the same typeface details) [S-L05-017] [S-L05-058].

cards.title: App icon system (iOS/macOS layered Liquid Glass, Android adaptive + themed, PWA)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Design one glyph built from 1-3 filled shapes on a solid or gradient background, and export it as Apple layers, Android foreground/background/monochrome, and a maskable PWA icon. Check it in tinted/monochrome first, since that is the hardest mode [S-L05-011] [S-L05-039] [inferred order].

cards.title: Logo in product and favicons
cards.block: Brand in product > Logo usage; Brand in product > Favicon
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Symbol-only logo at 24-32px in the app bar, full lockup on sign-in and marketing, neutral appearance inside dense tools. Ship the favicon set from one SVG master [S-L05-042] [S-L05-044].

cards.title: Photography art direction (subjects, perspective, light, color treatment, inclusion)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Write a one-paragraph photo brief (subject types, perspective, light, color treatment, casting) before commissioning or buying stock. IBM's test is useful for any brand: if an image "could have been created by any other organization", reject it [S-L05-047].

cards.title: Aspect ratios and cropping
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Allow 3-5 ratios (16:9, 3:2, 4:3, 1:1, and optionally 2:1) and assign one per component slot [S-L05-047] [inferred].

cards.title: Text and UI on images (overlays, scrims, protection)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Default to text beside images. When overlay is required (heroes), use a scrim token and test contrast against the worst-case region [S-L05-072] [inferred].

cards.title: Image loading, placeholders and fallbacks
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Always reserve the final box; use a neutral placeholder fill for images and skeletons only for container components [S-L05-068] [S-L05-071].

cards.title: Avatars (sizes, shapes, fallbacks, presence)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) 16-64 scale on a 4/8 rhythm; circle = person, square = entity, a third shape for AI agents if the product mixes human and AI actors [S-L05-066] [S-L05-069].

cards.title: Illustration style and brand personality
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Derive illustration geometry from things you already have: the icon stroke, the corner radius and the brand palette. Pick one primary style and at most one secondary (IBM runs three, but for a very large brand) [S-L05-049] [inferred].

cards.title: Illustration tiers and where they appear (hero, spot, empty state, patterns)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) In product, use neutral spots for routine empty states and colorful spots only for first-run and celebration; keep hero and collage work in marketing [S-L05-050].

cards.title: Emoji, stickers, 3D assets, animated icons and Lottie (summary)
cards.block: Foundations > Rich media > Emoji, 3D, animated assets
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Animate icons only to confirm an action or show ongoing status; keep 3D and Lottie for onboarding, celebration and marketing moments [S-L05-010] [inferred].

cards.title: Data-viz scope, chart library and chart-type guidance
cards.block: Foundations > Data visualization > Chart types and library
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Start with 5-6 chart types (bar, line, area, stacked bar, donut or meter, scatter) plus a KPI "big number". Theme an existing library rather than building one; Polaris Viz shows the maintenance cost of a public chart library [S-L05-077] [S-L05-080] [inferred list].

cards.title: Data-viz color palettes (categorical, sequential, diverging, status)
cards.block: Foundations > Color > Data visualization palettes (shared with L01)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) One brand chart color plus grey by default; a 6-8 step categorical sequence used in fixed order; add one sequential ramp per primary hue and one diverging pair only if the product shows above/below-target data [S-L05-075] [S-L05-083] [S-L05-086].

cards.title: Chart anatomy and chart tokens (axes, gridlines, labels, legends, tooltips)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Map chart chrome to existing text/border tokens and add chart-specific tokens only for marks and interaction states [S-L05-083].

cards.title: Chart accessibility (not color alone, text alternatives, data tables)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Every chart ships with a title that states the insight, direct labels or a legend with shape cues, a text summary, and a "view as table" option [S-L05-036] [S-L05-077] [S-L05-083].
